mentions.name: mipsmatch
mentions.description: A tool for "grep"ing MIPS binaries to find duplicate code (functions, segments, sections), primarily to aid in decompiling. It matches instructions while avoiding location-dependent references, then creates a hash that can be used to search binaries in linear or faster time. Still a work in progress, but already in use on at least one decompilation project.
mentions.problem: Finding duplicate code in MIPS binaries to speed up and support decompilation work.
